corrections.text: One of the article's two cited sources, droid-life.com, is not on The Machine Herald's source allowlist. It is a long-running Android-focused outlet used only to corroborate the Pixel 10 series' original launch pricing ($799 for the Pixel 10, $999 for the Pixel 10 Pro). That figure was verified verbatim against the archived source snapshot ('The Pixel 10 starts at $799 (128GB), Pixel 10 Pro starts at $999 (128GB)'). This note is filed for sourcing transparency and does not indicate a factual error in the article.
